Za vším hledejme expedici do Austrálie |url=https://www.ruik.cz/proc-maji-bohemians-ve-znaku-klokana/ |access-date=6 May 2023 |work=Ruik |date=14 February 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210303180022/https://www.ruik.cz/proc-maji-bohemians-ve-znaku-klokana/ |archive-date=3 March 2021 |language=cs}} | image = Bohemians Praha 1905.svg | upright = 0.75 | founded = {{Start date and age|1905|df=yes}} | ground = [[Ďolíček]] | capacity = 5,000 | chairman = Darek Jakubowicz | manager = Jaroslav Veselý | league = [[Czech First League]] | season = [[2025–26 Czech First League|2025–26]] | position = 10th of 16 | current = 2025–26 Bohemians 1905 season | website = {{URL|https://www.bohemians.cz/}} | pattern_la1 = _bohemians2425h | pattern_b1 = _bohemians2425h | pattern_ra1 = _bohemians2425h | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = 009150 | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = 009150 | pattern_la2 = _bohemians2526a | pattern_b2 = _bohemians2526a | pattern_ra2 = _bohemians2526a | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 5F04B4 | body2 = 5F04B4 | rightarm2 = 5F04B4 | shorts2 = 5F04B4 | socks2 = 5F04B4 }} '''Bohemians Praha 1905''', commonly known as '''Bohemka''' or '''Bohemians Prague''', is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Vršovice]], [[Prague]], Czech Republic. The club competes in the [[Czech First League]], the top division in the [[Czech Republic football league system]]. Founded in 1905 as '''AFK Vršovice''', the club won the [[1982–83 Czechoslovak First League]], its only league championship. Its traditional home colours are green and white and a stylized [[kangaroo]] serves as both emblem and mascot, which gave rise to its more recent nickname ''Klokani'' ("Kangaroos").{{Cite web |title=Historie Bohemians |url=https://bohemians.cz/historie |access-date=2025-11-17 |website=Bohemians Praha 1905 |language=en}} The best-known player from Bohemians' history is [[Antonín Panenka]], who is now the club chairman.{{Cite web |title=Antonín Panenka slaví narozeniny! |url=https://bohemians.cz/article/11391-Antonin-Panenka-slavi-narozeniny |access-date=2025-11-17 |website=Bohemians Praha 1905 |language=en}} Bohemians' mascot is a kangaroo, the legacy of a 1927 tour of Australia.{{Cite news |last=Ashdown |first=John |date=2010-09-21 |title=Why do a club from Prague have a kangaroo on their crest? |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2010/sep/22/why-do-club-prague-kangaroo-crest |access-date=2025-11-17 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}} Following the tour, the club was awarded two live kangaroos, which they donated to the [[Prague Zoo]].{{Cite web |title=About the Famous Kangaroos of Bohemians |url=https://www.zoopraha.cz/en/about-zoo/news/director-s-view/15194-about-the-famous-kangaroos-of-bohemians |access-date=2025-11-17 |website=Prague Zoo |language=en-gb}}"}}
